purpose: Determine whether a fixed real source supplies the exact joint interface needed to turn a generic self-reference boundary into a consumer-qualified HoTT mismatch.

criteria.name: fixed_real_interface
criteria.question: Is a concrete versioned theory, tool or public interface fixed?

criteria.name: code_and_proof_domain
criteria.question: Does its object domain contain the relevant code and proof objects rather than names alone?

criteria.name: checker_correspondence
criteria.question: Is the proof predicate or checker tied to actual acceptance for the declared fragment?

criteria.name: reflection_scope
criteria.question: Is soundness/reflection stated with exact assumptions, trust base and target scope?

criteria.name: same_layer_self_application
criteria.question: Does quotation/self-application remain in the same claimed layer without an outer theory or host primitive?

criteria.name: total_self_reliability_promise
criteria.question: Does the source actually promise total same-layer self-reliability, rather than checking, bounded search, restricted decision or relative correctness?

capabilities.meaning: check one supplied proof/term against a type or derivation relation
search within a declared finite fuel/grammar and return a checked result
decide truth or definitional equality only in an explicitly restricted fragment
the same system internally and totally certifies the soundness/completeness needed for its own proof predicate

sources.relation_to_hott: host interface used by Cubical Agda developments
non-HoTT dependently typed comparison system with a real self-quotation program
inner HoTT with an explicit outer metatheory

sources.system: Normalisation by Evaluation for Type Theory, in Type Theory
sources.relation_to_hott: type-theoretic internalisation comparison using a QIIT metalanguage

sources.system: local ERCF-3 object syntax and repaired coding
sources.version: worktree HEAD 1aa1a6 plus current uncommitted proof assets
sources.relation_to_hott: current project experiment; no natural consumer

selection_boundary: Primary official/project sources chosen for their direct interfaces: Agda reflection, MetaRocq checker/quotation/self-erasure, HoTT-specific 2LTT, NBE-in-type-theory and the current ERCF-3 construction. This is not an exhaustive literature census.
semantic_limit: A source qualifies only if Q1-Q6 are all PASS in the same fixed interface. Keyword or anchor presence never decides a criterion by itself.
